name: reldfs (time-aware relational DFS + LightGBM)
note: CPU-only, non-neural, non-LLM. Automated time-windowed aggregates over the schema's foreign-key paths (1-hop windows, 2-hop track records, grandchild and parent-context aggregates, day-level recency), cut strictly before each prediction time; LightGBM; per-task feature families chosen by a pre-registered rule on train-internal backtests; refit on train+val; 2-seed mean. Test labels are public, so this result is self-reported; test was scored once, locally, for this system (local 12-task mean AUROC 0.7742).
author: KenWuqianghao
